title: 第719章 未来发展方向会议第718章 我还会骗你们不成
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 林默心中一突，赶紧歉意开口道：
“不好意思啊各位同志，刚和泰拉各族谈完新合作的事，让大家久等了。”
换成别人，在这种级别的会议上迟到，会议室里的气氛绝不会轻松。
可看见林默进来，不少人反而露出了笑意。
这位年轻人可是大夏新贵，也是众人能好好活下去的原因，更是赵老如今的红人。
除开这些，林默刚从泰拉战场和科纳战场的双线事务里抽身，所有人都知道他这段时间有多忙。
他们也都约过林默的时间，想要好好拉近拉近关系，可都被新希望计划里的秘书给婉拒了，是真的实在抽不开身。
赵老原本没什么表情的脸上，见林默来了，浮现出一抹温和笑容。
“来了啊。”
他抬手招了招，朝着自己左手边示意道：
“快来，坐坐，就等你了。”
林默点点头，快步走到赵老左手边坐下。
途中，各个负责人纷纷向他微微颔首，包括赵刚等人。
林默也都一一回应。
等他坐稳，赵老看了一圈会议室，语气恢复沉稳。
“既然人到齐了。”
“会议那就开始吧，主要说说目前手头工作跟接下来的工作内容与发展方向。”
说完，他看向韩猊霸。
“你先说。”
韩猊霸点头，沉声道：
“科纳卫星登陆计划，第一阶段作战目标已经基本完成。”
“目前，四座传送门稳定运行，前哨阵地具备持续补给能力，外围警戒范围推进到三十二公里。”
“魔族这几天只派出小股部队试探，没有再组织大规模反扑。”
“基地建设正在昼夜推进。”
韩猊霸顿了顿，继续道：
“昨天，我代表大夏向科纳文明发送信息，要求结算第一阶段任务报酬。”
“这是科纳文明第一阶段的任务内容，奖励是一项科技。”
屏幕上随即弹出一行字。
【第一阶段任务：大夏在科纳卫星建立前哨站。】
【任务目标包括：形成可持续驻军、补给、防御、通信的桥头堡，并确保该据点能够长期存在。】
会议室里安静下来。
所有人都知道，这份报酬不只是钱，也不是普通物资。
而是科纳文明承诺给大夏的尖端科技。
在如今这个阶段，一项成熟星际文明技术，可能就意味着大夏少走几年甚至几十年的弯路。
content_en:
;;
Lin Mo had a sudden thought and quickly apologized and said:
"I'm sorry, comrades, I just finished talking about new cooperation with the Terran tribes, so I kept everyone waiting for a long time."
If it had been anyone else, arriving late to a meeting of this level, the atmosphere in the room would never have been relaxing.
But when they saw Lin Mo coming in, many people smiled.
This young man is a new member of the Xia Dynasty. He is also the reason why everyone can live well, and he is also Mr. Zhao's current celebrity.
Apart from these, Lin Mo had just withdrawn from the dual-front affairs of Terra Battlefield and Kona Battlefield. Everyone knew how busy he was during this time.
They all made appointments with Lin Mo, wanting to get closer and closer, but they were all declined by the secretary in the New Hope Project, and they really couldn't get away.
Mr. Zhao's originally expressionless face showed a gentle smile when he saw Lin Mo coming.
"Here he comes."
He raised his hand to wave, and motioned to his left:
"Come on, sit down, I'm waiting for you."
Lin Mo nodded, quickly walked to Mr. Zhao's left hand side and sat down.
On the way, everyone in charge nodded slightly to him, including Zhao Gang and others.
Lin Mo also responded one by one.
After he sat firmly, Mr. Zhao looked around the conference room and his tone returned to calmness.
"Now that everyone is here."
"Let's start the meeting. We will mainly talk about the current work at hand and the next work content and development direction."
After speaking, he looked at Han Yiba.
"You say it first."
Han Yiba nodded and said in a deep voice:
"The first phase of the Kona satellite landing plan has been basically completed."
"Currently, the four portals are operating stably, the outposts have continuous supply capabilities, and the peripheral warning range has been extended to 32 kilometers."
"The demons have only sent out small groups of troops to test in the past few days, and have not organized any large-scale counterattacks."
"The base construction is progressing day and night."
Han Yangba paused and continued:
"Yesterday, on behalf of Daxia, I sent a message to the Kona Civilization, requesting the settlement of the first phase mission rewards."
"This is the mission content of the first stage of Kona Civilization, and the reward is a piece of technology."
A line of words popped up on the screen.
[First phase mission: Daxia establishes an outpost on the Kona satellite. 】
[The mission objectives include: forming a bridgehead for sustainable garrison, supply, defense, and communications, and ensuring that the stronghold can exist for a long time. 】
The conference room fell silent.
Everyone knows that this reward is not just money, nor ordinary materials.
It is the cutting-edge technology that Kona Civilization promised to Daxia.
At this stage, a mature interstellar civilization technology may mean that Daxia avoids a few years or even decades of detours.
title_en: Chapter 719 Future Development Direction Meeting Chapter 718 Will I lie to you again?
